seams.title: Replace a life total being reduced to 0 or less
seams.clause: If your life total would be reduced to 0 or less, instead transform this creature and your life total becomes 3. Then if this creature didn't transform this way, you lose the game.
seams.why: The only life floor is game/life_floor.go (PlayerStatic.LifeFloorOne, Angel's Grace): it clamps DAMAGE at 1 and has no 'instead' body. Enduring Angel replaces any event that would take the life total to 0 or less (damage, life loss, a set-life effect), runs a body (transform, set life to 3), and must know whether the transform happened (CR 701.28 can't-transform cases, a second Angel already transformed). Expect a new player-level replacement beside life_floor.go, applied where damage and life loss settle, plus a 'did it transform' result from the transform call.
seams.checked: grep -rniE 'reduced to 0 or less' effects: 0. grep -rniE 'life total would|LifeFloor|less than 1' effects game: angels_grace.go and game/life_floor.go only (damage only). grep -rniE 'EventWouldLose|WouldLoseGame|LoseGameReplacement' game: 0. grep 'didn.t transform|TransformForEffect.*bool' effects game: only CanTransformForEffect (game/cant_transform.go:55). captive_audience.go has 'your life total becomes 4' for the set-life half.

seams.title: Add a flashback cost that removes X counters and sets the spell's X
seams.clause: Flashback—{3}{R}, Remove X loyalty counters from among planeswalkers you control. If you cast this spell this way, X can't be 0.
seams.why: AlternativeCost.RemoveCounters (game/alternative_cost.go:342-363, #5390) is the right component but is fixed-count only: its comment says effects.Register holds it 'to the among form with a from clause and a fixed count'. Here the number removed is announced by the caster, must be at least 1, and becomes the spell's X (the printed cost {X}{R} is not paid). Extend CounterRemovalCost.Variable (already used by activated abilities) to the cast path, feed the announced total into the cast's X, and add a FlashbackRemoveCounters constructor in effects/alternative_cost.go beside FlashbackSacrifice.
seams.checked: grep -rniE 'loyalty counters from among|Remove X loyalty' effects game: 0. grep -n 'RemoveCounters: ' effects/alternative_cost.go: one use (line 347, fixed N). game/counter_cost.go:60-110: Variable exists for abilities ('any number', Mage-Ring Network).

seams.title: Return a card to the battlefield transformed and attached to a target
seams.clause: When this creature dies, return it to the battlefield transformed under your control attached to target creature or planeswalker an opponent controls.
seams.why: The back face (Strangling Grasp) is an Aura, so the card must enter back face up already attached to the trigger's target (CR 712.14a, CR 303.4f names the case where the effect does specify the host). game.ReturnFromGraveyardTransformedForEffect(cardID, controller, tapped, counters) has no host argument, and ReturnCard has Transformed but not EntersAttachedTo (that field is on SearchLibrary only). Add a host to the transformed return and to ReturnCard; an illegal host leaves the card in the graveyard.
seams.checked: grep -rniE 'transformed under your control attached|transformed.*attached|attached.*transformed' effects game: 0. grep 'Transformed: *true' effects: convert.go, garland_knight_of_cornelia.go, the Ojer gods, optimus_prime_hero.go (none is an Aura back face). ls effects | grep -E 'accursed_witch|radiant_grace': neither is in the catalog. EntersAttachedTo: effects/primitives.go:1204, game/effect_api.go:2298 (search only).

seams.title: Add a mana restriction tag for paying a disturb cost
seams.clause: {T}: Add {U}. Spend this mana only to pay a disturb cost or cast an instant or sorcery spell.
seams.why: Mana restrictions are a closed tag vocabulary in game/mana_restriction.go. 'Cast an instant or sorcery spell' is ManaRestrictAnyType and the OR is ManaRestrictAnyOf, but no tag names the alternative cost a cast is being paid with: ManaSpendContext carries zone, purpose and characteristics, not the AlternativeCost.Key. cast:from-graveyard is too wide (it would admit flashback and escape). Add an 'alt:<key>' tag and carry the claimed alternative's key in ManaSpendForCastParams.
seams.checked: sed -n 81,200p game/mana_restriction.go: the tag list (purpose:*, cast:from-exile, cast:from-graveyard, type:, subtype:, color:, ...). grep -nE 'alt:|AltKey|Alternative|disturb' game/mana_restriction.go: only the SpendOnlySources comment at :506. grep -rni 'disturb cost' effects: 26 files, all Disturb(...) declarations, none a spend restriction.

Watch item: stop and report if SourceLKI cannot tell a spell on the stack from a permanent. Rem Karolus needs RowLabels on both replacements. Ludevic: ExileXFromGraveyardAsCost (activated.go:1033); Olag: 'as this transforms into …, it becomes a copy of a creature card exiled with it, except …' (assimilation_aegis.go:52 and sephiroth_one_winged_angel.go for 'as this transforms'; docs 'Adding a copy effect'); watch item, stop and report if a copy with name/P-T/type exceptions cannot be applied at transform time. Shadow Kin: dimir_doppelganger.go / lazav_dimir_mastermind.go ('becomes a copy of that card, except it has this ability'), choosing among the cards milled this way. Hostile Hostel: soul counters, transform then untap; Creeping Inn counts cards exiled with it and phases out. Jerren: 'exactly 13 life' intervening if with a may-pay. Guards: a helper returning a StaticAbility or ReplacementEffect needs a Label or RowLabel; creature-type and colour words are read through source.TextSubtype / ctx.TextSubtype; a one-sentence trigger is built from effects.Do primitives with a footprint; a card that reads as a board wipe declares its Sweep; an 'X target' spell must be castable by the probe in server/internal/legal.
